tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// gser 'od rnga sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so/// /

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ su warṇa bha wa smri taṃ ge nā ma dhā ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ gser 'od rnga sgra zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ nub gcig bdag gi rmi lam na// stong gsum thams cad rnga sgras gang*// de dag thams cad gser rnga ste// kun kyang rnga sgra 'ur ru ru// rnga sgra de la phar nyan pas// rnga dbyangs sna tshogs 'gyur zhing 'bar// rnga 'od 'bar ba nyin bzhin mtshar// rnga sgra chen pos stong gsum g.yos// gnam sa kun kyang 'gul zhing ldeg /mtsho chen kun kyang 'khrug cing rnyog /ri rab kun kyang bsnyal zhing 'jig /klu phrug kun kyang nyams mi bde// bar snang kun kyang rab tu 'khrug /de ltar rnga 'od rnar nyan pas// ji ltar mthu chen g.yul g.yo ba// 'jig rten mgon po su yi mthu/ phyogs bcu'i khams su phar bltas pas// khams gsum de dag thams cad na// sā la'i shing drung re re na// rin chen stegs bu mtho tshad du// btsun pa sangs rgyas re re bzhugs// de bzhin sā la'i yal ga la// btsun pa sangs rgyas re re bzhugs// sangs rgyas re re'i zhabs drung du/ byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas// gnam gyi me tog char bzhin 'bab// gnam sa rim pa'i lha kun gyis// tshig bzang snyan po du mas bstod// de dag sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// tshig bzhin mtshungs par gsung phyung ba// gsang sngags rnga sgra 'di dag smras/ gser 'od dam pa rnga sgra'i gzungs la/ tadya thā/ bhu ga na mno ra the/ du hu du hu/ ya mad tsa na surya a bā bha sa te/ ya bad tsa na tra do'u dang te paṃ/ ka rakṣa man da na ta bar ma ku ru swā hā/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gser 'od dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo// tadya thā/ ud to li/ tsi ri tsi ri/ ud to ri/ to ra na ma/ shan to shan to/ ud to li/ hu lu hu lu swā hā/ mi dang*/ mi ma yin pa dang*/ rgyal po la sogs pa zlog par 'gyur ro// gzungs la/ tadya thā/ dan ti thi ge

/ka ra thā/ ko'u ra thī/ ke yu re dan ti la swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das gser 'od dam pa rnga sgra'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// gzungs la/ tadya thā/ shi ri shi ri/ di mi di mi di mi di mi ni/ shi ri shi ri ni/ da ri da ri ni/ bi sha la bi sha la/ pa sha ni pa sha ni pa re swā hā/ sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gzungs la/ tadya thā/ hi ri hi ri ni/ tsi ri tsi ri ni/ ka ri ma ma ni/ sma pa su ni/ dzi bha ni si staṃ bha ni/ ma hā ni sa ya sa bu ka swā hā/ rgyal po dang bar du gcod pa thams cad zlog par 'gyur ro// oṃ badzra yag sha kro dha hūṃ/ rā dza kro ta aṃ ku sha dza dzā/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi hūṃ/ oṃ badzra kro dha rā dza si ti a mṛ ta hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ badzra bu ru lu bu ru lu hūm̐/ oṃ badzra rag sha rā dza dum bu dum bu bcing*/ thum ma le thum ma le rā dza bhyo dza dza/ badzra rag sha rā dza tsi ta zungs/ kha rag rma sha rbad rbad/ khu na dum bu shig /dha na ra rag sha tsi ta phyung rbad/ zlog na rā dza tsi ta rbad/ gtubs gtubs rā dza tsi ta gtubs/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ gri hna gri hna hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ gri hnā pā ya gri hnā pā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ā na ya ho bha ga wan/ bidyā rā dza hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rag sha nan tsakra nan/ 'byung po la shwa nan/ sum ta rag sha nan/ dam sri the'u nan/ gnod tshabs che na 'don par gsungs// gnod med rnams la bton gyur na// rnam smin 'bras bu rang la 'byung*// gzungs 'di 'don par bya'o// na mo ratna tra yā ya/ krad kri ku ti ku ti ni/ i ri mi ti/ ko sha ni/ i mi ni ni/ i ni li swā hā/ oṃ serna dras tan trig nan/ e hur thums dza ma ra ya rbad/ rgyal po dang*/ gnod byed kyi gdon rnams kyi mgo 'gas par 'gyur ro// gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// byol song khams kyi sems can kun// mi dran ngan pa'i sems bor te// shes rab nyi ma 'char bar shog

/gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// yi dwags khams gyi sems can kun// nyon mongs sna tshogs byed pa dag /yi dwags bdud rtsi thob par shog /gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// sreg cing btso ba'i sems can kun// zil dngar bsil ba'i char babs te/ nyon mongs de kun rang zhi nas// bla med gnas su phyin par shog /gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// chags shing sred pa'i sems can kun// shes rab nyi ma'i 'od phyung ste// nyon mongs thams cad zhi bar shog /gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// bcad cing gtubs pa'i sems can kun// bcad gtubs thams cad zhi gyur te/ bdud rtsi btab cing sos par shog /gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// thig nag btab pa'i sems can kun// nyon mongs sna tshogs yongs zhi ste/ bla med rgyas pa'i skyid spyod shog /gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// mun nag 'khod pa'i sems can kun// yid bzhin rin chen 'od byung ste// nyes sdig legs nyes mthong bar shog /gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// lcags sdong 'dzeg pa'i sems can kun// mi bde thams cad yongs bral te// byang chub shing la 'dzeg par shog /gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// mtshon gyi char 'bebs sems can kun// chos kyi yul khams 'dir skyes te// bsil dngar chos kyis snum par shog /gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// 'khor ba de dag thams cad las// kun kyang 'jig rten las 'das pa// khams gsum nang na btsun par shog /gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// stong gsum khams kyi sems can dang*// de bzhin mtha' med sems can rnams// gshin rje'i khams kyi mya ngan dang*// ngan par 'gro ba'i mya ngan dang*// dbul por 'gro ba'i mya ngan dang*// 'jig rten khams kun zhi bar shog /gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// sems can 'jigs pa'i skyabs byas te// khams gsum mya ngan gdung ba dang*// byang chub sangs rgyas thugs rje yis// bsil dang 'jam pa'i char phab ste// nyon mongs kun kyang bde bar shog

/gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// gegs kyi ngan sems kun zhi nas// sangs rgyas byang chub myur thob ste// mgon po'i chos kun thob par shog /gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// mtha' 'khob skye ba'i skal dman kun// yul gyi dbus skyes zin pa des// chos byed rgyal po 'phrad par shog /sdig can snying rjes phyi ma thob// gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// 'on lkugs glen pa'i sems can dag /de dag gegs yul gar skyes kyang*// shes rab byang chub sems thob ste// bla med yang dag gnas su shog /gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// dmus long 'thoms pa'i sems can kun// snang gsal chos kyi lam grub nas// chos mig gtsang dang 'phrad par shog /gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// yod par lta ba'i mi dag kun// dran 'dzin dang sems ma g.yos te// bshes gnyen byang chub sems 'grogs shing*// don kun dge ba byed par shog /gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// mtho ris btsun pa'i sar skyes dang*// mtho btsun skyes pa'i sems can dag /sgrib pa de dag kun bsal te// bla med chos kyi zhi ba thob// gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// khams gsum btson ra yongs bral te// 'khor ba'i mya ngan rgyun kun bshig /bdud kyi sde kun bshig bral te// bla med yang dag gnas su shog /gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// sems can thams cad thos so cog /byang chub snying rjes ma g.yos te// kun la khyab pa'i brtse ba yis// 'jig rten pha ma byed par shog /gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// sems can thams cad thos so cog /bla ma'i bka' bzhin byed pa dang*// seng ge'i sgra dbyangs 'byin par shog /gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// sems can thams cad thos so cog /grangs med sdig lci la sogs pa// thengs gcig thos pas kun byang ste/ bla med yang dag gnas su shog /gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// dug gsum spyod pa'i sems can dag

/byang chub spyod pa'i thabs legs te// khams gsum snying rje char bzhin 'bebs// gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// lha bran khams kyi sems can kun// rgyags dregs drag po'i sems bor te// nga rgyal btang snyoms glags rnyed pas// 'dres rtog ting 'dzin mi g.yo spyod// gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// mi yul khams kyi btsan phyug dag /'dod pa lnga yi sems bor te// sdom pa gsum gyi chos la spyod// mya ngan rgya mtsho zhig par shog /gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// sems can nyon mongs med par byed// sdug bsngal gsum gyi mdud pa bcad// khams gsum btson ra 'dra bas na// de phyir khyod ming 'jig rten mgon// gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// bdud sde log pa'i khams kun zhi// lnga phung bum pa khyod kyis bshig /de phyir khyod ming bcom ldan 'das// khyod kyi me long ye shes kyis// ma shes mi mthong ye nas med// de phyir khyod ming thams cad mkhyen// gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// khyod la mi nyan gcig kyang med// thos so cog gis bsod nams 'thob// byed rgyu kun kyang rgyal ba'i chos// de phyir khyod ming seng ge'i bu/ shing drung rgyal por 'dug pa ste// bdud bzhi sder bcas btul bas na// dpa' bar 'gro ba khyod yan no// de phyir khyod ni rgyal ba yin// gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// sems can mang po khyod kyis drangs// gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// sems can nyon mongs khyod kyis bor// de phyir mtshams med khyod la bstod// gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// gzugs dang ming dang gzugs sogs pas/ mtha' yas gar yang khyab pa'i lus// bltar med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ lnga phung gzugs kun khyod kyis bor// rtog med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// chos kyi rang bzhin dbyings med pas// thos so cog gis bshad pa med// gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// dbyer med rtag tu khyod bral bas// brtag med kun kyang khyod kyi lus// rtog med de la phyag 'tshal lo/

gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// chos kyi sa bon btab med do// chos thos gcig la skye ba med// snying rje bas ni kun la byams// de phyir khyod ming 'jig rten mgon// gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra 'dis// sing rje bas ni kun la byams// khyod kyis khams gsum btul nas kyang*// sdug bsngal kun gyi skyabs gyur shog /de phyir sems can pha zhes bya// gegs kyi gnod pa zhi gyur cig /ces gsungs so// dur tri pra ma rbad rā dza tshal pa tiṣṭha tre'u tsi ta rni rā dzā dur snying la rbad/ dun ting da me mo bān ta ya/ shel gyi srog rtsa ma ra ya rbad/ a ya ma du rā dza sha na sha ya ma 'byung po nan/ gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so/// /su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā/ u rgyan gyi slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis snyigs ma'i dus su sems can rnams la phan par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ lha srin sde brgyad gnod 'tshe byed pa dang*/ khyad par snyigs ma'i dus su rgyal po gdon du ldang bas de'i gnya' gnon du mdzad do// bsam yas kyi dbu rtse khams gsum zangs khang gling gi sgo khang byang ngos su gter du sbas pa dus phyis mnga' bdag nyang ral pa can gyis gter nas bton te/ sde brgyad dang rgyal pos nyen pa rnams la 'gro don du spel ba lags so// 'di shin tu bka' gnyan pas gang gi khyim na bzhugs pa tsam gyis rgyal po la sogs pa'i gdon gyis glags lta bar mi nus so// tshar gsum las mang bsgrags na/ lha srin sde brgyad dang*/ khyad par du rgyal po la sogs pa'i gdon rnams la sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yod gsungs so// 'di shin tu bka' gnyan pa dang dkon pa'i chos lags so// sa ma ya rgya rgya// bkra shis/// /
